outline.unique_angle: A first-person, measured dev-diary account framing this as a copy-paste decision a solo dev makes in a chat box — not abstract 'context engineering' or agent auto-loading. The concrete spine the top-3 all lack: a named failure (AI inventing a method that 'should' exist from surrounding patterns), a specific rule (changed function + 3-5 callers + tests), and a before/after on hallucination rate dropping to near zero. Ties hallucination cause (pattern-fill on noisy context) directly to the manual paste habit, which none of the three competitors connect.
